newsitem.title: USA: Arkansas rice crop condition improves slightly.
newsitem.headline: Arkansas rice crop condition improves slightly.

text.p: The Arkansas rice crop improved slightly last week to 76 percent good to excellent as of Sunday, above the 75 percent in that category the previous week, according to the Arkansas Agricultural Statistics Service.
Twelve-percent of the rice crop had headed, below the 47 percent a year ago and below the 32 percent average pace.
Th soybean crop condition declined to 50 percent good to excellent, below the 60 percent in that category the previous week.
Thirty-six percent of the crop had bloomed, below the 49 percent a year ago and below the 39 percent average pace.

The weather was hot and humid most of the week with temperatures five degrees above normal in most areeas. Livestock conditions deteriorated from the previous week because of the heat, the report said.
